content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis lacks explicit estimand attributes (population, variable, summary measure) in text",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of proportion of patients achieving an IGA score of 0 or 1 on hand and foot at week 16 will be analyzed using the Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel (CMH) test",
      "page": 86,
      "section": "11.4.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text describes the statistical test but does not explicitly define the estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events strategy, summary measure) in the narrative; Table 2 is referenced but not fully quoted, and the summary measure (e.g., risk difference or odds ratio) is not stated.",
      "fix": "Explicitly state the estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events strategy, summary measure) for the primary endpoint in the text, not only in a table."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing data handling for primary endpoint not specified in text",
      "quote": "The primary estimand of interest, the intercurrent event(s) strategy, and missing data handling methods for the primary endpoint (binary response) are described in Table 2.",
      "page": 86,
      "section": "11.4.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text defers missing data handling to Table 2, but the table content is not provided in the extracted text, leaving the actual method (e.g., multiple imputation, non-responder imputation) unspecified in the protocol narrative.",
      "fix": "Include the missing data handling method in the text or ensure Table 2 is fully included in the protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size justification incomplete: no power/significance level stated",
      "quote": "sample size will yield >95% power to detect a treatment difference of 24% in the proportion of",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sentence is cut off and does not specify the two-sided significance level (alpha) or the assumed placebo response rate, which are essential inputs for sample size calculation.",
      "fix": "Complete the sample size section with full details: assumed placebo rate, alpha, power, and any continuity correction or test used."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints lack individual analysis methods",
      "quote": "Secondary Endpoints for Efficacy: • Proportion of patients with improvement (reduction) of weekly average of daily hand and foot peak Pruritus NRS ≥3 from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lists many secondary endpoints but does not specify the statistical analysis method for each (e.g., CMH, ANOVA, logistic regression). Only the primary endpoint has a detailed analysis method.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection under Statistical Methods that describes the analysis approach for each secondary endpoint (or reference a table that does)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoints lack any analysis description",
      "quote": "Exploratory Endpoints [p41] • In patients with AD lesions on other parts of the body in addition to hands and feet; − Percent change in EASI score from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 41,
      "section": "4.1.4",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Exploratory endpoints are listed but no statistical analysis methods are provided for them in the statistical plan section.",
      "fix": "Include analysis methods for exploratory endpoints, even if descriptive or hypothesis-generating."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity control not described for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "Secondary Endpoints for Efficacy: • Proportion of patients with improvement (reduction) of weekly average of daily hand and foot peak Pruritus NRS ≥4 from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not mention how type I error will be controlled across the multiple secondary endpoints (e.g., hierarchical testing, Bonferroni).",
      "fix": "Add a section on multiplicity control for secondary and exploratory endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing data handling for secondary endpoints not specified",
      "quote": "Handling of missing data due to the COVID-19 pandemic and any additional analyses required to investigate the impact of COVID-19 to understand estimated treatment effect and safety will be detailed in the SAP.",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The text only mentions COVID-19-related missing data; general missing data handling for secondary endpoints is not described.",
      "fix": "Specify general missing data methods for all endpoints (e.g., mixed models for repeated measures, multiple imputation)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent sample size: 130 patients but cap at 100 adults implies at least 30 adolescents, yet no adolescent-specific analysis plan",
      "quote": "Approximately 130 patients (65 patients per arm) will be enrolled at approximately 50 global sites. The number of adult patients will be capped at approximately 100 to ensure that, at a minimum, approximately 30 adolescents will be enrolled.",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "7.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The sample size includes a minimum of 30 adolescents, but the statistical plan does not describe any subgroup analysis or separate power consideration for adolescents, which may be an analysis gap.",
      "fix": "Add a note on how the adolescent subgroup will be analyzed or state that the study is not powered for subgroup analyses."
    }
  ]
}
